situation: the surface carries a Qurʾānic annotation mark (U+06DF ۟, small high rounded zero) after the alif; a normalizer that only strips U+064B..0652 leaves it, so قَالُوا۟ != قَالُوا and the wave matches 0 rows
wrong_action: declare the token missing / unmatched and route it to scholar
correct: extend the diacritic-strip range to U+06D6..06ED in every normalizer so annotation marks are stripped for matching but the PUBLIC surface stays byte-exact
reason: annotation marks must be transparent to matching yet preserved in the rendered token; matching-normalization must never mutate the public bytes

situation: proclitic bi- + wasla-alif + stem; resplitting by base-letter count must place each combining mark on its own base letter so segments concatenate byte-exact to the original
wrong_action: carve on codepoint offsets, which can attach a kasra/wasla to the wrong base letter and break concat or recolor a base letter
correct: resplit by BASE-LETTER count (each base letter plus its trailing combining marks travels together); assert segment concat == token surface byte-exact
reason: the renderer invariant is exact concatenation; a diacritic-only tanwin/case mark must ride its base letter and never take a colour class of its own
